tags.feature: Sand rocks can now be broken on Brickyard
Magic Essence and Bone now have priority to spawn on The Sorcerer's Heart

notes.title: Wild Life Update Announcement - October 20th

notes.title: Patch #6: Production Query

We'll roll out a [b]news update[/b] later with some more details.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]We're listening to you[/h3][p]As said previously, we are listening to every [b]feedback[/b] we get, so keep'em coming! notes.title: Patch #4: Customization and New Ways
notes.content: [h3]Change log version [b]1.0.4 (50)[/b]:[/h3][p][/p][h3][b]CONTENT[/b][/h3][list][*][p]You can now name your settlement (Village)[/p][/*][*][p]Composter now can craft Manure out of 2 Poop[/p][/*][*][p]You can now sell Equipment to the Traveling Merchant[/p][/*][*][p]Every other NPC has a Kisil Coin action now (Herbalist sells Chlormeleons by the way) 👀[/p][/*][*][p]Endless Mode is available only after Expert difficulty wins now[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]QUALITY OF LIFE[/b][/h3][list][*][p]You can now stack Bone cards on Sawmill to craft Bone Flute[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the zoom out range[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the board (table) area[/p][/*][*][p]Priority spawns will now stack to the nearest card (Potatos and Ovens for instance)[/p][/*][*][p]Nothing can be stacked with Outhouse now, only Poop (no interrupted Poop disposal)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]FIXES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed hint/equipped cards minor bug[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Recipe Book search + click card of same type bug[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug on tutorial where you got stuck on craft Well quest[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where you could when and trigger the No People event dialog above the End Game Panel[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where on switching/resetting profiles the Customization data didn't update[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]We're listening to you[/h3][p]As said previously, we are listening to every [b]feedback[/b] we got, so keep'em coming! New patches will arrive.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Thank you[/b] for your trust in us and make sure to join us on CrafTAE's [url="https://discord.gg/dmnWEFzyNg"]Discord[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p]mappe[/p]

tags.feature: You can now name your settlement (Village)
Composter now can craft Manure out of 2 Poop
You can now sell Equipment to the Traveling Merchant
Every other NPC has a Kisil Coin action now (Herbalist sells Chlormeleons by the way) 👀
Endless Mode is available only after Expert difficulty wins now
You can now stack Bone cards on Sawmill to craft Bone Flute
Priority spawns will now stack to the nearest card (Potatos and Ovens for instance)
Nothing can be stacked with Outhouse now, only Poop (no interrupted Poop disposal)

tags.bug: Fixed hint/equipped cards minor bug
Fixed Recipe Book search + click card of same type bug
Fixed a bug on tutorial where you got stuck on craft Well quest
Fixed a bug where you could when and trigger the No People event dialog above the End Game Panel
Fixed a bug where on switching/resetting profiles the Customization data didn't update
